3. Taking into consideration the fact that in the present FIR, petitioners have been arrested on the basis of allegations to siphon off huge amount of complainant and other Investors in the name of promotion of Company, for the similar allegations petitioners have been booked in several other FIRs in different States, though against accused-petitioner-Anubhav Mittal has been implicated in 277 criminal cases and accused-petitioner- Ayushi Mittal has been implicated in 241 criminal cases,
but all are of similar nature and according to the counsel, both the petitioners have been granted bail in the other FIRs as well, offences are triable by Magistrate; petitioners are in custody since 26.05.2024, after investigation, charge-sheets have been filed and conclusion of trial may take considerable time, but without commenting on merits of the case, this Court deems it just and proper to release the petitioners on bail.

4. Accordingly, these bail applications are allowed and it is ordered that the accused-petitioners (i)
Anubhav Mittal S/o Sunil Mitta and (ii) Aayushi Mittal D/o Raghuveer Saran, shall be released on bail provided each of them furnish a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- with two sureties of Rs.25,000/- each, out of which one should be of local surety as petitioners are resident of Uttar Pradesh to the satisfaction of the learned trial Judge for their appearance before the court concerned on all the dates of hearing as and when called upon to do so.
5. However, it is hereby directed that the petitioners shall not repeat the similar nature of offences and cooperate with the trial and shall not tamper with/ threaten/ induce the prosecution

during bail granted by this Court.

In case, breach of any of the condition is reported or comes to the notice of the Court, same shall be the reason for the trial Court to cancel the bail, granted by this Court.
